notes.title: Patch 2.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The engine migrate from Unity 5.4.1 to Unity 2018.2.16
[*] The design reworked and migrate from Unity OnGui to Canvas.
[*] Thanks Canvas redesign the FPS was improved considerably. 
[*] Patch size 1.9GB
[/list]

[i]From Developer to community: [/i]

The UI has been redesigned to improve the quality of the game. In addition, the new design will allow me to add new main (playable) characters to the game.
Now I am working on 2 new characters and a network of randomly generated dungeons.
The game will get more "Hack & Slash" elements in the future. Also, the spells of the Goblin character will be corrected soon.

notes.notes:
Night is lighter now. Moonlight added. (Players feedback was: "night is to dark")
Darkmana added. First dark mana spell "Wyvern Apocalypse" added. Costs 5 darkmana. Darkmana is equal 1 raid/wave. 
UI: Darkmana placed close to mana bar.
UI: "Wyvern Apocalypse" added to bottom spell bar.

UI: " Arcane Light " added to bottom spell bar.

Player cant leave PvP game during the fight.

notes.title: Beta Patch 5.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Graphic:[/h1]
	- night was redesigned.
	- grass and trees looks realisticer now.
[h1]PvP is now availaible[/h1]
	- character has 1 PvP skill for each level:
		1. Summon Ogre
		2. Summon Archer
		3. Summon Dark Torturer
		4. Surprise MF
		5. Dungeon Portal
		6. Dragon Breath
		7. Flock of Wolfs
		8. Summon Shaman
		9. Explosive Rabbit
		10. Walls
[h1]3 New unique heroes were added:[/h1]
	- [b]Witch[/b] is a caster hero. Witch has 6 different spells, which she casts randomly. Witch has also 3 teleportation skills, which makes her more powerful. Level 2+: if her health is 2 time lower then maximal amount of health, she teleports to the goblin. Level 4+: if her health is 3 time lower then her maximal amount of health, she teleports to the Forester House. Level 6+: if her health is 4 time lower then her maximal amount of health, she teleports to the random side of the forest. She still can be onehit. Each skills can be used automatically 1 time during the fight.
	- [b]Imp[/b] is a mighty flying creature. Imp is connected with your forest. If he fights close to the tree, he strikes stronger and restores health. For every meter distance from the closest tree imp becomes penalties. If closest tree is 9 meter or farther his damage is 10 + attack damage. For every meter close to the next tree he becomes +10 damage, so if he is 1 meter or close to the tree, his damage is 90 + attack damage. Level 2: if imps health lower than 40 health, he automatically destroys 20 random trees in your forest and restores his maximal amount of health. Level 4: if imps health lower than 55 health, he automatically destroys 10 random trees in your forest and restores his maximal amount of health. Level 6: if imps health lower then 70 health, he automatically destroys 5 random trees in your forest and restores his maximal amount of health. This skill still does not help against onehit.   
	- [b]Otherside[/b] is an undead wolf hero. Otherside is much stonger during the night. Level 2: every hit restores 1 health during the night. Level 4: every hit restores 3 health during the night. Level 6: every hit restores 6 health during the night.

Soundtrack was completely redesigned

Character level cap: 10
New session always starts in the night.
Trees level 5 can be upgraded with night lamps.
26 new art of mushrooms were added.
5 new enemies were added.
Enemy graveyard were added.
Enemy portals with guards were added.
Shadow enemies drop dark souls. Dark souls have 100 health and explode in 5 sec if you do not kill them.
Burning enemies were added.
Few new scrolls were added.

notes.title: Beta Patch 4.0
notes.notes:
[b]Upgrade and information system in the the game was completely overwritten. [/b]
    - All units, heroes, buildings and almost everything in your forest can be upgraded now.
    - After every wave all objects (even trees and mushrooms) in the game receive 1 skill point. You can skill one of 6-7 attributes: defence, magic defence, health, attack, detect range and attack distance(only range units).
    - All units and heroes become experience during the fight. 
    - Levelup give units and heroes 5 skill points.
    - Archer level 2 receives fire arrows. Archer level 3 receives homing arrows.
    - Upgrade usability feels now much easier to understand and work with. 
    - Colored onhover and onhover information helps player to feel comfortable in the game.
[b]New art of units are now available in the game: Heroes[/b]
    - Heroes can not be bought. 
    - Heroes come in your forest only if you character has level 5 or higher.
    - Heroes have unique characteristics and become level 2,4 and 6 unique abilities.
    - 5 new heroes are available now: Ogre Money Maker, Orc Traveler, Wintertale, Mishka and Kaba.
    - Heroes stay in your forest not for free. Few of them like Money Maker and Traveler must be paid every wave. Another like Wintertale, Mishka and Kaba kills every wave different animals in your forest.
    - Not paid heroes leave your forest immediately.
    - What kind of heroes come in your forest depends on different factors, like buildings, killed units, wild animals and units under your command.
[b]Heroes Overview:  [/b]
Kaba is an evil boar race coming from southlands. This creature patrols your forest. Every time the fight begins it kills first one neutral creature. Kaba randomly chooses his animal victim. Thanks his aggressive behaviour, Kaba also gains more experience. His additional damage is equals of the amount of killed monsters of all time, but can't be more than 100. 

Mishka is an old bear race coming from north. This creature patrols your forest. Every time the fight begins it kills first one neutral creature like rabbit, hare, stag, old stag or deer. Mishka randomly chooses his animal victim. Mishka does additional damage for every bear in your forest. Level 2: Every attack movement has a chance of 1% to damage enemy with powerful attack, where damage = count of trees in the forest; Level 4: 3 % Chance; Level 6: 5% Chance. 

Called Money Maker not for fun. This hard defensive warrior takes every enemy wave so much money as his level is, but only if he is involved in the fight. He patrols your forester. If you can not pay, Ogre Money Maker will leave your forest. Level 2: redroper 2; Level 4: redroper 3; level 6: does triple damage.

Orc Traveler has 2 magic weapons, which restore foresters mana and health after level 4 and 8. Orc takes every enemy wave 1 gold, but only if he is involved in the fight. He patrols your forester. If you can't pay, Orc Traveler will leave your forest. Level 2: restore 1 health by forester for every hit; Level 4: restore 1 mana by forester for every hit; level 6: +1 experience for hit.

Wintertale is a beautiful strong wolf race coming from north. This creature patrols your forest. Every time the fight begins it kills randomly one of your livestock or a wild animal. Wintertale restore his health every bite: 10 health + 1 health for Wintertales level. Level 2: restore 1 health for the bite; Level 4: restore 3 health for the bite; Level 6: restore 6 health for the bite.
[b]Secondary skills were completely overwritten.[/b]
    - All skills now make sense.
[b]Skills Overview:[/b]
- Ogre: every hit has a 2% chance to increase attack +1 permanently
 -Ogre: every hit + 1 experience
- If Ogre Money Maker one of your heroes, all ogres and orcs(except heroes) do additional damage. Additional damage is equals unit level. Also unit restores every hit health equals unit level*2
- Ogre: every hit has a 1% chance to increase def +1 permanently
- Ogre: every hit has a 2% chance to strike with triple damage
- Old Archer: shoots an additional fire arrow + 20 damage
- Old Archer: + 5 Distance
- Old Archer: every shoot + 2 experience
- Old Archer: + 5 Distance
- Old Archer: shoots after short break an extra homing arrow(10 damage)
- Old Archer: shoots an extra homing arrow(50 damage) against shadow enemies or werewolfs
- Treant heals 40 health points
- Treant heals all units
- Forester House and Fake Forester House Incoming: +1 gold; +2 coins
- Shamans collect trees much faster: -8sec Shamans and Imps destroy dungeon walls: -8sec
- All melee non hero units do twice damage
- All melee non hero units restores every hit health equals unit level
- All range non hero units (Shamans, Trolls and Old Archer): + 5 range
- All non hero units: every hit has 2% chance to restore full health
- All non hero units: every hit has 2% chance to increase defence and magic defence +1 permanently
- All non hero units: every hit has 2% chance to increase maximal health +1 permanently
- Goblin: +3 Health every 10 sec
- Goblin: +3 Mana every 10 sec
- Goblin: +3 Health every 7 sec
- Goblin: +3 Mana every 6 sec
- Goblin: -5 sec teleportation countdown
- Goblin: If character has lower than 50% health he teleports himself in the middle of the map. 180sec. countdown
- Goblin: If character has lower than 50% health he freezes the time to 90%. Forester inclusive, 180sec. countdown
- Goblin: If character has lower than 20% health he transforms closest enemy in the enemy chicken with 1/1 health.240 sec. countdown
-Goblin: If character has lower than 10% health he transforms closest enemy in the random tree. 300sec. countdown
- Troll: every spell cast restore 10 health
- Troll: every spell cast does additional 20 damage
- Trolls have increased range attack: +5
- Troll: every spell cast + 1 experience point
- Orc: every hit has a 2% chance to increase attack +1 permanently
- Orc: every hit has a 10% chance to increase speed +1 sessionally. Maximal 10x stackable
- Orc: every hit has a 3% chance to increase def +1 permanently. Ogre House should be min. level 3");
- Orc: every hit has a 7% chance to does double damage. Ogre House should be min. level 5
- Heroes only(Money Maker, Orc Traveler, Wintertale, Kaba, Mishka, Imp, Witch, Spirit Shaman): every hit +1 experience point
- Heroes only(Money Maker, Orc Traveler, Wintertale, Kaba, Mishka, Imp, Witch, Spirit Shaman): every hit restores 1 health point
- Heroes only(Money Maker, Orc Traveler, Wintertale, Kaba, Mishka, Imp, Witch, Spirit Shaman): every hit has 2% chance to restore full health
- Heroes only(Money Maker, Orc Traveler, Wintertale, Kaba, Mishka, Imp, Witch, Spirit Shaman): every hit has 2% chance to increase maximal health +2 permanently
- Dark Torturer: -5 sec Dark Passenger countdown
- Dark Torturer: -5 sec Lightning Teleportation countdown");
- Dark Torturer does every strike an additional damage: 20
- Cow: +1 gold incoming
- Chicken: +2 coins incoming
- Goat: +1 gold incoming
- Sheep: +1 crystal incoming
- Pig: +1 crystal incoming
[b]Other changes:[/b]
- 5 new plans added in the game, all 5 are different kind of towers.
- 4 new traps added in the game: vortex trap, forest trap, first blood trap, bad teleportation trap.
- 14 Shadow enemies, 5 poisoned enemies and 8 invisible enemies are added in the game.
- 4 enemy portals added in the game.
- Hotkeys added. Like 'f' - for fences summon or 't' for trees summon.

[i]also hundreds of bugs were fixed in this patch.
all data was reset.
max level cap 11. [/i]

- Redesigned sessional item system.
- Hotkeys for trees, fences, mushrooms and other objects.
- Portals.
- Over 30 new 'shadow' and 'poisoned' enemies.

notes.title: Patch 3.0 released
notes.notes:
Game difficulty was reduced. 
Maximal character level 11.

Character level for all spells were reduced.
2 new important characteristics added: Fear and Aggro.
Energy ball make sense now. Damage and mana costs was increased. Energy ball aggro enemy unit to attack you next 5 second. 
Weather influences lightning. Lightning can be cast only during rain. Character level for Lightning reduced from 5 to 3. 
Normal fear duration: 5 seconds.
Night influences fear. Fear duration 10 seconds during the night. Fear also does 15 damage during the night. 
Night increase experience for undead units.

Repair added.

New level information after level up added.

Tutorial added.

Logbook added.
HP bars for all buildings added.

Mana and health regeneration increased. Its level depends now.

Sell sound added.

Waves are completely randomized. 

New Building Fountain:
	Allow you restore mana and health.
New Building: Prison
	Prison is multifunctional, allow shaman to transform dead orcs, ogres and trolls, also ogre and troll bosses to skeleton. Prison has a 20% chance to block one enemy from fighting against you in this turn.
New Building: Witch House
	Witch House allow you to upgrade trolls.

All Buildings receives few upgrade.

New Units:
	Dark Torturer and Trolls

Archer has 4th upgrade. 
Mutation added in the game. first mutation receive orc and ogre. Player can decide between upgrade or mutation after third upgrade.
Forest Soul Skills: 
	Mage path: alchemists, which tower, fountain. 
	Defender path: Ogre House, Tower, well, 
	Forester path: Well, hote, fountain
depends on buildings the forest decides which path you chosen and gives you bonus: spell, skills and stats. 
Mage path gives you new spell: professional teleportation; and few stats. 
Forester path gives you new spell: Queen of the flock; and few stats.
Defender path gives you stats.

Traps receive upgrades.

Forester House can't be sold anymore. 
Player got no more aggro if enemy attack wild animal.
Items can be used as a button. (Just click on useful item)

Player receive more attention if allied unit get damage.

new UI  elements added.

Undead health bug fixed.
Bear and wolf naming fixed.
Barbarians bug fixed.
Bug: running character after teleportation fixed.
Fixed some UI problem after spell casting.
Ancient tree save problem fixed.
Secondary skills were fixed.

notes.title: Beta patch 2.0
notes.notes:
I think many of you were disappointed of Dark Forester state in Early Access phase. There were to many bugs, and the game was not even close in alpha version. The game was somewhere between alpha and prototyp. There were no gameplay.
Today's patch is in my opinion how the game, also Dark Forester should start in Early Access. Patch 2.0 change almost everything in the game. It has more changes than it was in all patches together. Pathfinding and AI works good. I overwritten experience system and added some sessional parts of the game, like items, wave for experience and wild animals. I did first steps in neural network (read more below in patch notes).
I start right now first PvE season with rating and prizes. 20 Player who reach level 7 first will win each 3 Dark Forester keys for friends. Just chat me after reaching level 7.
Season 1 until 01.04.2017: Best 5 Player receive each 5 Dark Forester keys. Also best 20 player will get an Ancient, the strongest unit in the game.
Rating: http://www.darkforester.com/bestpveplayeren.php  
Darkforester page were redesigned: http://darkforester.com/

Please read carefully all updates and features of patch 2.0. I also want to thank many of yours for feedback and chat messages. I really appreciate that.

- First and the most important, path finding system was complete overwritten, works fine now. 
- Session Items added. All items are sessional. Player can have only 1 item to each of the 6 item. types. Hotkeys for scrolls using are R,T,F,G,B.
	- Item type Weapons (8 weapons added)
		- Orc Axe
		- Normal Axe
		- Archers Joke
		- Experience Staff
		- Mighty Staff
		- Ogre's Hammer
		- Strange Fish
		- Great Sword
	- Item type 'R' - Magic Scrolls (4 scrolls added)
		- Firehay Scroll (Instantiate the fire hay to the mouse pointer. 500 Damage)
		- Tree Transform Scroll (Transform any enemy unit to the tree)
		- Teleportation 1 Scroll (Teleport player in the middle of the map)
		- Teleportation 2 Scroll (Teleport player to the mouse pointer)
	- Item type 'T' - Weather Scrolls (4 scrolls added)
		- Day Scroll (Set the Day)
		- Night Scroll (Set the Night)
		- Rain Scroll (Call the rain)
		- Tornado Scroll (Call the tornado for the next 10 minutes, damage 50 every third 		second)
	- Item type 'F' - Potions (3 potions added)
		- Health Potion (Restore full health)
		- Mana Potion (Restore full mana)
		- Experience Potion (+ 50 Experience)
	- Item type 'G' - Monster/Trap Scrolls (3 scrolls added)
		- Bear Scroll (Summon Bear for the next 10 minutes)
		- Explosive Rabbit Scroll 
		- Wolf Scroll (Summon Wolf for the next 10 minutes)
	- Item type 'B' - Building Scrolls (1 Scroll added)
		- Fake House Scroll (Fake House is like a Forester House Level 1. Fake House is not 		sessional and have all benefits of Forester House Level 1. Fake House has only 300 		health.)
- Wild Animals added. About two dozen of wild animals live now in your forest. Wild animals system is important feature for the Dark Forester (and next patches). Also birds added in the forest. All animals are neutral and do not attack first. If wild animals health falls to the 10% of his maximum, then speed falls to the minimum. Wild animals bring less experience then enemies. 
- Two new Buildings added for character level 1-7
	- House on the Edge
		+ 3 random wild animals.
		10% chance to call a spectral wild animal after the start of the battle.
		House is neutral
		House works only on the edge of the forest. (Check: in the pond  appears water)
		Bonus: awakens ancient (just drop him in the pond)
	- Alchemist's House (1 Update available )
		-After every wave 50% chance to receive one of the following goods:					Crystal, New mush room type, gold, coins, mana or health potion.
- Experience and level system was overwritten. 
	- Level on hover you can see how many experience you need before next level.
	- After level 3 you need not only the experience, you should also complete 10 waves in one 	session.
	- All enemies give you experience based on the power and health amount.
	- Killing an enemies with Scroll Tree Transformation do not give you experience.

- Magic was redesigned. UI was also redesigned.
	- energyball, fireball, waterball, hammerball, meteor, arcane size and collider fixed.
	- energyball, fireball, waterball, hammerball, meteor, arcane fly to the mouse pointer on the 	fixed height.
	First three magic schools were changed. Because it's now harder to rich level 7 (close to 70 	waves). Your character obtain magic skills faster.  
-progress has been reset.
- Few critical bugs was fixed.
- Performance by game loading is few time faster.
- Performance about 10 FPS more during normal phase in compare to Beta 1.0. 
- Performance about 30 FPS more during combat phase in compare to Beta 1.0.
- Object Exploder was optimized, performance won about 5 FPS.
- Minicamera follow the camera now, not the player.
- Window mode display name was fixed.
- Main menu redesigned.
- 4 new mushroom arts (only in Alchemists House available)
- Damned trees appear during every fight. Only shamans can collect them. Damned trees is the only one chance to receive wood resource.
- Hotkeys updated
- Road collider was fixed.
- Game restart bug fixed.
- Infinity waves.
- Drag and Drop shower position was fixed.
- Monster drops only items which they can use.
- Maximal coins counter fixed.
- Gallow counter fixed.
- Forest Souls skills will be available after level 10. 
- Heavy bug fixed. Enemy archer corpse gave +1 units counter.
- Lose if you have lower than 30 Trees.
- Fences burn effect removed.
- Well burn effect fixed, counter problem fixed, also explode effect fixed.
- Drag And Drop performance and some UI elements updated.
- Insurance after player death or forester house demolition.
- Few UI onhover mistakes fixed.
- Character Information UI updated.
- Barrel health onhover fixed.
- Skills reset bug fixed.
- Sound by animated trees fixed.
- Day is now 24 minutes, including 7 minutes night.
- Enemy waves do not set the night.
- Over 100 sounds effects added.
- Archer received 2 updates. first update: fire arrows, second update: homing arrows.
- Ogres have only 1 'redroper', after update 2 and then 3.
- Orcs have 2 'redroper', after update 3.
- 15 different enemies and 40 different enemy specifications were added in the game.
- Enemy shamans and caretaker added in the game.
- 6 bosses added in the game, few are really great like Reaper and Nightmare.
- And at least Werewolf added in the game. After completing path finding system, i begun working on different model behaviour for the enemy units. Right now Werewolf is the strongest and cleverest unit in the game. He attacks first livestock. If he lose half of his health, he is looking for stag in the forest, he kills him and recover full health, and then come back. In retreat phase his speed increases by 3. If there are no more stags in your forest he will attack wolfs and bears - it is fatal for your forest. But werewolf is not just character with unusual abilities.
Werewol is first char who goes also in neural network direction. With patch 2.0 werewolf collect in database 5 information's: who did last hit on werewolf, how long werewolf were in fight, how many time he was killed with fire hay, how many times he was killed with explosive rabbit, how many times he was transformed in the tree. This is Phase 1 for werewolf: Collecting Information.
All players worldwide by killing werewolf send information to one central place for analyse.
Next patches will collect more information's and then go in Phase 2: Cluster Analysis.
Last Phase is: Neural Network.

notes.title: Next Patch, Future and price policy
notes.notes:
After 2 week sales price goes back to 29,99$ 
i decided to stop making a little content patches and concentrate on global big patch.
After almost a year i see, that it was a mistake to put the game (alpha) to early access, because most of people await complete prepared product and does not really help during early access phase. 
At least i still think that early access is the great feature by steam!!! 
With raising prices, i would like to avoid purchase bevor next global patch is out there.
Next Patch will contain many great futures, but the most importants are:
- Pathfinding (AI)
- 3 First Campaign missions
- Random Generated Forest
- Prelude to Dungeons

- Primary skills for basic, fire, lightning, earth schools added (max. level 17)
- 19 new spells (Apocalypse, fire rain, meteor, dooms hammer, fire rock, lightning ball, earth shield, freeze time etc)

notes.title: Alpha Patch 1.0 released
notes.notes:
Magic Shop completely overwritten, drag and drop function added. (The idea of magic shop is the same which was promised in forest construction) 
Drag and Drop/Rotate Icon deleted. Now just use left mouse button to drag any object.
Meele units can be dragged during the fight. (It should resolve some infight problems)
First Person Camera added.
Switcher between First Person Camera and RPG Camera.
Mushrooms Resizer added. Resizer works during First Person View (just click on mushroom and scroll wheel mouse button).
Game and Graphic performance 20% better now. 
PvP is now after level 6 available.
Step Phases changed.
Events added:
Ingame Events like undead (read more information below)
World Events: Wild Animals - spawn 3 random wild animals on the map.
Undead Event 2 and 2x Barbarian Events.
Dragon Iland Event: Starts 1 Oktober (Rewards 1% chance of Dragon)
Joker Event: Starts 1 November (Rewards 1% chance of Casino)
Over 10 enemies added: Dragons, Joker, Angry Chickens and more.
New allied creatures added: Warlord; Treant, Horror Mushroom, Boletus
New Function Garrisons added; Player can set an Ancient, Forest Tower, Magic Soul or Tornado to some position of the map.
Character level max 17.
New upgrades for existing buildings were added
New Traps are available
Teleportation Door is available.
Improved AI
Drag and Drop mouse problem resolved 
Game saves music settings
PvP and PvE energy added 
Daily quests
Achievements added but not activated. (coming soon)
Goblin Dreams 3 added. 
Goblin Dreams 1 many changes.
PvP: Ground Catapult added
PvP: Boat Commandos added
After death character loses only some resources (not level anymore).
After destroying a Forester House the character loses some resources.
Ogre House: Ogre Warlord and Ogre Fake King are secrets now. (Player should understand how to summon them)
Mood and Weather Indicator added
Mood Indicator green (more than 100 Trees, Units damage slightly increased)
Mood Indicator red (Units damage slightly decreased)
After pvp win appears game automat, where you can win additional rewards. 
After wave you can choose between gold or experience reward.
Switch sun: click on sun indicator to change between normal and fantasy blue sun.
New epic rewards: heroes for Tavern.

Spells speed fixed, now is constant
Energyball is stronger now, but costs more mana.
Lightning costs lower mana during the rain
Unholy Strike added (lvl 16)
Unholy Strike makes more damage during the night.

Meele, Caster, Range receives new icon on minimap
(Minimap is still in the game, but i think after First Person View and possibility to scroll map i'll delete minimap in the future)

Day, night, fog effects changes slowly now (3min) 
Day-Night-Day: 56min.
Night comes in 21min.
Ingame night event added: Undead Event (every 21min comes undead units)
Reset Day: player can reset day, if you want to avoid undead incoming. 

New Turn: Enemy number appears
Random Monster Spawn

Trolls damage reduced, trolls costs 5 gold now and need 2 unit places.
Snow effect deleted. 
Graveyard now after level 22 available.

Unkilled ogre bug fixed
Fountain new animation after drinking
Secondary skills '-1' bug fixed
Trees high fixed
Fences and Ogre House disappearing effect added 
Spawner effect fixed
Detect and Range sight fixed by many enemies
Time traps problem fixed
PvP and Observation text bugs fixed.
Character Information has actual number of trees now
Shaman Text bugs fixed.
Heroes bug fixed, resting effect added.
Fireball text fixed
Teleport text fixed


Take a look at darkforester.com 
Next patch content: 100 primary skills(more about skills coming soon), 20 pvp skills, 10 forest skills, weapons and procedural generated forests.
